q1.q: Does this app belong to Hoa Phat Group?
q1.a: No. This is a community app built by an individual. It is independent and does not represent Hoa Phat Group.

q2.q: Do I need to sign in to browse?
q2.a: No. You only sign in to post, chat, save listings or join groups.

q3.q: Will my phone number be exposed?
q3.a: Public pages do not show phone numbers. Only signed-in users can reveal the number on a listing by tapping the button, and each reveal is logged.

q4.q: What should I do about a scam listing?
q4.a: Never send a deposit before you meet and see the item. Tap Report on the listing or profile so moderators can review it.

q5.q: How do I delete my account?
q5.a: Go to Settings and choose Delete account. Your content is hidden immediately and your data is permanently deleted after 30 days.

q6.a: Vietnamese, English and Chinese. Change the language in Settings or at the bottom of the page.
